notes.title: Patch Notes for 30/11/2023
notes.content:
The latest update has been released. 

Changes in the most recent patch include:-

[list]
[*] 20 base achievements added
[*] Improvements to spectator functionality
[*] Global item drop rates have been tweaked
[*] Weather fixes and improvements
[*] Preparation for event/content changes
[*] UI fixes and hidden item UI elements when playing in "No Pickups" events
[*] Several performance, bug fixes and improvements for both platforms.
[/list]

Please note that some content is still subject to change, including map content and functionality.

We appreciate all of the support and feedback given throughout the Early Access period and have more changes incoming and planned for the near future and over the holiday period and thank you for your participation!

notes.title: Progress Report | 13/10/2023
notes.content:
Over the past few weeks we've made a lot of progress throughout the game, to recap, here is a short overview of the changes as of the current patch:-

[list]
[*] [b]Multiplayer[/b]: Work Races
In the mode, you must collect and put away as many crates as possible into your designated warehouse. 

Pickups are present within the mode with an exclusive addition: the "Max Fork Speed" pickup. When activated, your fork will lift objects at the fastest rate, for 60 seconds. Player warehouses also feature a functional door.. as although not advised, players are now able to get off their forklift.

To try out the mode, either join a game or host your own through [b]Play -> Race Settings[/b] - select 'Work Race' and then choose any of the "Work" maps from the map selection option and host the game by selecting [b]Play -> Multiplayer -> Host[/b]!

[*] Oil Spills can now be avoided through the use of Boosts
To help with balancing of the game, the effect of Oil Spills can now be countered by using Boosts. Oil Spills are now cleared after 60 seconds have passed.

[*] Items around the tracks were also adjusted - each pickup has the chance of giving players 1 or 2 of any of the available pickups in the current event. "Crates" were also added to the roster which allow for players to throw crates at nearby opponents. 

[*] New characters
[*] Countdown to next event now begins after the 3rd player crosses the line.
[*] [b]Singleplayer[/b]: AI spawning moved to the beginning of the game.
[*] [b]Singleplayer[/b]: Several fixes for AI, notably when resetting to track.
[*] Benchmark button has been renamed to 'Auto-Apply' - pressing this button will test your hardware and determine the best overall settings, apply & save them.
[*] Several performance fixes for both platforms.
[*] Hotfix for rare crash when calculating race positions.
[*] Hotfix for getting out of bounds in Warehouse #2
[*] Fixes with countdown announcer sync & handling tweaks and changes based on feedback.
[/list]

Please note that some content is still subject to change, including map content and functionality.

We appreciate all of the support and feedback given throughout the Early Access period and have more changes incoming and planned for the near future and over the holiday period and thank you for your participation!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 22/08/2023
notes.content:
A small update is now available to download which fixes some issues:
[list]
[*] Added "My Garage" scene
[*] Adjusted item rarity table to make newly-added items more common.
[*] Fixed issue when being teleported upon going out-of-bounds.
[*] Fixed issue which allowed the host to start the countdown multiple times. 
[*] Fixed issue where singleplayer sessions were unable to proceed past the second event.
[/list]

Another update is expected to go live throughout the day.

notes.title: Progress Report | 12/08/2023
notes.content:
In the short time we released our first Early Access build we've had a lot of valuable feedback which has already seen a lot of changes made to the game, with more to come soon.

Importantly, fixes for networking and multiplayer and graphical optimisations have been deployed with more coming! 

More changes since our first build include:-
[list]
[*] New track: Warehouse #2
[*] 2 new items
[*] Redesigned pickups
[*] Retuned Forklift physics
[*] New mode: 'Crate Dash'
[*] Lots of new forklift body paint materials
[*] Lots of bug fixes, improvements and optimisations
[/list]

Pickups now have a closer to final representation in-game and among the item changes are [b]Oil Spills[/b]. This item lets you strategically drop a small slick of oil around the track to slow down opponents who pass through it! Also listed is the addition of the 'Warehouse #2' track: situated in a large storage warehouse which has been cleared out for the events by the participating Forklift Operators & Managers.  


As we now progress further through development we intend to post regular patch notes to accompany all patches which are released and thank you for your support & feedback!
